fit_linear_references: fit linear element references for target properties using a dataset and least squares regression
create_element_references: create a LinearReferences module from a .pt or .npz file or state dictionary
LinearReferences_dereference: remove linear element references from target tensors using an AtomicData batch
LinearReferences_forward: add linear element references back to target tensors using an AtomicData batch
load_references_from_config: load or fit element references from a config dictionary and dataset
